name: The Hidden Gazebo Eatery
notes: Both photos show the same fixed multi-course tasting menu card (one flat, one on a table); text identical and fully legible in both, no prices printed anywhere on the card.

dishes.name: The Pyramid
dishes.description: Slow-cooked beans finished with preserved lemon, served alongside three pyramid-shaped sourdough bites. Drizzled with parsley oil and garnished with microgreens, house pickles, black sesame, and edible flowers.

dishes.name: Touch to Reveal
dishes.description: At first, only microgreens and edible flowers rest atop a delicate tuile. A gentle touch shatters the crisp shell, revealing freshly fried falafel nestled into a bed of house-made garlic tahini.

dishes.name: Freshness Heaven
dishes.description: Cherry tomatoes, feta, and fresh mint nestled inside a cucumber ribbon. Light, bright, and finished with microgreens and edible flowers.

dishes.name: Let It Be Cold
dishes.description: A gently warmed, slow-cooked chickpea soup infused with our signature Egyptian spice blend. Comforting, aromatic, and deeply grounding.

dishes.name: Traditional Lamb
dishes.description: Tender, slow-braised lamb in a rich tomato sauce, enriched with lamb bone marrow for depth and richness. Served over fragrant rice and finished with seasonal vegetables, microgreens, and edible flowers.

dishes.name: Koshary (Vegan)
dishes.description: A traditional Egyptian classic: rice and black lentils layered with spaghetti and chickpeas, topped with house tomato sauce and crispy fried onions. Served with garlic vinaigrette and our signature spicy sauce to finish to taste.

dishes.name: Drink Me Up
dishes.description: Chilled hibiscus tea—floral, tart, and refreshing.

dishes.name: Bring Me Home
dishes.description: Freshly baked black double-chocolate sourdough, served with seasonal fruit or house fruit syrup, gold accents, tahini, and Egyptian black honey. Finished with toasted nuts for texture and depth.

dishes.name: Crunchy Freshness
dishes.description: Golden konafa layered with fresh cream, topped with seasonal fruit, toasted nuts, and delicate gold leaf.
